items.criterion: Use MathWorld Fibonacci Number page as source
items.description: Agent uses the MathWorld page (https://mathworld.wolfram.com/FibonacciNumber.html) as the source of truth for all reported items. Full credit if the agent clearly bases the recurrence, initial conditions, first eight positive-index Fibonacci numbers, and OEIS identifier on the MathWorld page. Full credit also if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to access MathWorld but it is inaccessible (down/CAPTCHA/error/block) and the agent explicitly reports the blocker and that it cannot proceed within constraints. No credit if the agent reports values from memory or other sources without attempting/using MathWorld when it is accessible.

Report the Fibonacci recurrence exactly as displayed on the MathWorld page, preserving mathematical notation. Full credit for the correct recurrence with exact symbols/formatting as shown. Partial credit if the correct relationship is given but notation deviates from MathWorld’s display. If MathWorld is inaccessible after a reasonable attempt and the agent clearly reports the access blocker, award full credit for this criterion (since extraction is impossible). No credit if the recurrence is incorrect/missing when MathWorld is accessible or if the agent fabricates content.

Report the initial conditions exactly as displayed on the MathWorld page, preserving mathematical notation. Full credit for both initial conditions exactly as shown. Partial credit if initial conditions are correct but not in MathWorld’s displayed form. If MathWorld is inaccessible after a reasonable attempt and the agent clearly reports the access blocker, award full credit for this criterion. No credit if incorrect/missing when MathWorld is accessible or if the agent fabricates content.

items.criterion: Report first eight positive-index Fibonacci numbers (F1–F8 only)
items.description: List the first eight positive-index terms as F1 through F8 (exclude F0), matching the MathWorld page’s displayed sequence values. Full credit if all eight terms are correct and correspond to F1–F8. Partial credit if 5–7 terms are correct or if F0 is incorrectly included but the F1–F8 values are otherwise present. If MathWorld is inaccessible after a reasonable attempt and the agent clearly reports the access blocker, award full credit for this criterion. No credit if fewer than 5 correct terms when MathWorld is accessible or if the agent fabricates content.

items.criterion: Report linked OEIS identifier (exact as displayed)
items.description: Provide the OEIS identifier linked from the MathWorld page for the Fibonacci sequence, preserving the identifier exactly as displayed (e.g., formatting like 'Axxxxxx'). Full credit for the exact identifier. Partial credit if the correct OEIS entry is referenced but the identifier is not preserved exactly (typo/formatting). If MathWorld is inaccessible after a reasonable attempt and the agent clearly reports the access blocker, award full credit for this criterion. No credit if missing/wrong when MathWorld is accessible or if the agent fabricates content.

items.criterion: Respect stopping condition and scope constraints
items.description: Agent stops after recording: recurrence, initial conditions, first eight positive-index terms (F1–F8), and OEIS identifier; does not add unrelated information or follow unrelated external links. Full credit if the response contains only the requested items (and no extra exploration/output beyond them). Partial credit if minor extra irrelevant content is included but requested items are present (or, if blocked, the agent stops after reporting the blocker). No credit if the agent omits requested items due to excessive unrelated navigation/content, follows unrelated links, or fails to stop appropriately.
